SOURCE_ID.description:
Publisher-stable, lowercase identifier of the source in the provider's
registry of sources.

SOURCE_KIND.description: What kind of data the source supplies.

ORIGINATOR.description:
Agency, operator or catalog that created the source data, as it names
itself. Not a message's CCSDS ORIGINATOR, which names who created the
message.

PROVIDER_ID.description:
Identifier of the provider that published the product, as the provider
names itself: the module, node or service that retrieved the source data.

PRODUCER.description:
Identifier of the software that made the product from the source data,
with its version when it has one.

LICENSE_CLASS.description: What the source's terms permit for the product.

LICENSE_ID.description:
Identifier of the terms LICENSE_CLASS was read from: an SPDX license
identifier where one applies, else the identifier of the terms in the
provider's licence register.

LINEAGE.description:
Identifier of the lineage the source's data descends from. Sources that
republish one upstream share its lineage, so their products are not
independent of each other.

SOURCE_URL.description:
Replayable URL or provider query identifying the source material as it
was retrieved (the SOURCE_URL of $CMR and $AVL).

SOURCE_VERSION.description:
Source revision, edition or upstream update marker verbatim: for a file
its originator stamps, the stamp.

RETRIEVED_AT.description: RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond time the source material was retrieved.

SOURCE_SHA256.description:
SHA-256 of the exact source payload bytes as retrieved, 64 lowercase
hexadecimal characters. Empty when the source cannot expose replayable
bytes.

SOURCE_BYTES.description:
Number of source bytes SOURCE_SHA256 covers: the length of the prefix when
the source was fetched by range. 0 when not stated.

PRODUCER_SHA256.description:
SHA-256 of the build of PRODUCER that made the product (its dist
module.wasm), 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. Stamped by the host
that loaded the producing module: a module cannot hash its own bytes.
Empty when not stated.

RDEShielding.description: Shielding configuration for dose and TID calculations.

MATERIAL_NAME.description: Descriptive material or layup name when CUSTOM or MULTI_MATERIAL.

RDEShieldCurvePoint.description: One point on a depth-dose shielding curve.

DOSE_RATE_MSV_H.description: Computed dose rate behind this thickness in mSv/h.

TID_KRAD_SI.description: Computed total ionizing dose over the window in krad(Si).

RDEPassDose.description: Integrated radiation exposure for a single belt or SAA pass.

PASS_ID.description: Unique pass identifier within the assessment window.

IN_SAA.description: True when the pass traverses the South Atlantic Anomaly.

IN_BELT_CORE.description: True when the pass traverses a primary trapped radiation belt core.

PEAK_DOSE_RATE_MSV_H.description: Peak instantaneous dose rate during the pass in mSv/h.

INTEGRATED_DOSE_MSV.description: Total integrated dose accumulated during the pass in mSv.

PEAK_L_SHELL.description: Peak McIlwain L-shell reached during the pass.

RDEElectronicsEffect.description: Spacecraft electronics single-event effects (SEE) and total ionizing dose (TID) assessment.

DEVICE_PROFILE_ID.description: Reference device or part hardness profile identifier.

SEL_PROBABILITY.description: Single-event latchup probability over the assessment window (0..1).

SEB_SEGR_RISK.description: Single-event burnout / gate rupture risk metric (0..1).

TID_KRAD_SI.description: Total ionizing dose accumulated over the window in krad(Si).

TID_MARGIN_PCT.description: Remaining TID design margin in percent.

LET_THRESHOLD_MEV_CM2_MG.description: Linear energy transfer threshold in MeV*cm^2/mg.

RDECrewDose.description: Human crew dosimetry and career limit tracking.

CREW_ID.description: Crew member or mission role identifier.

EFFECTIVE_DOSE_MSV.description: Whole-body effective dose over the window in mSv.

CUMULATIVE_CAREER_MSV.description: Updated cumulative career effective dose in mSv.

CAREER_LIMIT_FRACTION.description: Fraction of applicable career limit consumed (0..1+).

RDESepEffect.description: Solar flare / solar energetic particle (SEP) asset impact entry.

NOAA_S_SCALE.description: NOAA Solar Radiation Storm scale S1..S5 (0 if below S1).

SEP_DOSE_MSV.description: Additional SEP event dose in mSv.

SOLAR_CELL_DEGRADATION_PCT.description: Estimated solar array power degradation in percent.

STAR_TRACKER_BLINDING_MIN.description: Estimated star-tracker blinding duration in minutes.

RDE_ID.description: Unique identifier of this radiation effects record.

NORAD_CAT_ID.description: NORAD catalog number of the target spacecraft (0 for uncataloged/crew trajectory).

WINDOW_START.description: Inclusive assessment window start, RFC 3339 UTC.

WINDOW_END.description: Exclusive assessment window end, RFC 3339 UTC.

RBF_RECORD_IDS.description: Referenced $RBF radiation belt flux record identifiers.

INSTANT_DOSE_RATE_MSV_H.description: Instantaneous dose rate at WINDOW_START in mSv/h.

ORBIT_AVG_DOSE_RATE_MSV_H.description: Orbit-averaged dose rate over the assessment window in mSv/h.

TID_KRAD_SI.description: Total ionizing dose in silicon over the window in krad(Si).

PASS_DOSES.description: Per-pass dose breakdown across belt and SAA transits.

SHIELDING_CURVE.description: Depth-dose attenuation curve across shielding thicknesses.

ELECTRONICS.description: Electronics SEE and TID margin assessment.

CREW.description: Crew organ and career dose assessment when crewed.
